card.name: Linking words inside MELAS disease name
card.fires_on: The word "with" or "and" inside the full name "mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes", in metformin mitochondrial-disease warnings.

modes.label: with after encephalomyopathy
modes.example: Mitochondrial Diseases: Metformin may increase the risk of lactic acidosis in patients with mitochondrial diseases such as mitochondrial encephalomyopathy<< with>> lactic acidosis, and stroke-like

modes.label: and after lactic acidosis
modes.description: The word "and" after the comma following "lactic acidosis", before "stroke-like episodes".
modes.example: formin may increase the risk of lactic acidosis in patients with mitochondrial diseases such as mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis,<< and>> stroke-like episodes (MELAS)

card.plain: It fires on the small linking words inside the disease name MELAS when it is spelled out in a metformin warning.
